items.headline: Nvidia pauses 'AI Compute Partnership' revenue-share financing deals with smaller AI cloud providers over antitrust concerns
items.note: Nvidia pulled a vendor-financing backstop that smaller neoclouds leaned on to bridge GPU capex ahead of customer contracts, right as scrutiny of circular AI financing intensifies.

items.headline: IREN posts $639M FY26 impairment charge and debt load surges to $7.6B as it pivots from bitcoin mining to AI cloud
items.note: Non-cash impairments from decommissioning bitcoin-mining hardware plus a jump in total debt to fund GPU buildout illustrate the balance-sheet strain smaller neoclouds are taking on to chase AI compute demand.

items.headline: SoftBank's dollar bonds post biggest one-day drop since April, CDS widens, as it weighs $10-20B bond sale to refinance $40B OpenAI bridge loan
items.note: Existing SoftBank 8.5% 2036 notes fell ~2.3c and CDS widened ~11bp on reports it may sell up to $20B in new bonds to refinance the bridge loan backing its OpenAI stake, continued forced-refinancing stress in the AI shadow-financing chain.

items.headline: Broadcom's 5-year CDS jumps 28bp, bond yields +14bp, as it backs a $60B+ off-balance-sheet AI chip-financing deal
items.note: Credit markets are pricing in the risk of Broadcom's guarantees on large AI chip-financing backstops, with its CDS move outpacing Oracle's and SpaceX's over the same period.

items.headline: Nvidia's 5-year CDS spread hits a fresh high (~80.77bp), more than double its late-May level
items.note: The move surpasses Nvidia's late-July peak and comes amid scrutiny of its ~$500B compute-collateral financing push with Apollo, Blackstone, BlackRock, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR.

items.headline: Data-center CMBS deals from CyrusOne (KKR) and QTS (Blackstone) reprice wider than initial guidance as AAA spreads widen to 168bp over SOFR
items.note: Two of the last three data-center CMBS deals had to widen pricing to clear, and AAA spreads are up from 153bp a year earlier, signaling investors are growing more selective on AI-tenant credit quality and leverage.
